caption_link.limitation: The source provides matching numeric IDs only. It does not provide an original post URL, date, media link, or an explicit asset-to-caption key.

inspection.evidence_scope: Source-bound start, material-intermediate, and near-complete frames were extracted from the original local GIF and visually inspected; metadata came from that same source file.

motion_sampling.method: Three source-bound frame samples extracted from the original local GIF for review; no derivative was added to the corpus.
motion_sampling.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

visual_anatomy.title: A four-level strategy title uses one long lavender rough-display tag and immediately asks the reader to self-locate.
visual_anatomy.layout: A large five-row maturity table compares four labelled levels across post formats, content-type mix, engagement, AI use, consistency, required input, and results.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Title and self-assessment question → choose a level column → read down its repeated dimensions → compare a row horizontally only when investigating a particular maturity trade-off.
visual_anatomy.typography: Large thin headline, bold level headings, strong row labels in a shaded left index, and compact sans annotations with custom visual micro-encodings.
visual_anatomy.colour: Lavender headings and index cells frame a white table; pastel green, peach, aqua, pink, blue, and lavender encode content-type slices and outcome bars.
visual_anatomy.surface: White background, fine purple table rules, rounded metric pills, pie diagrams, small calendar grids, coloured bar marks, and restrained inner shadows.
visual_anatomy.modules: Four maturity columns crossed with seven dimensions, with each row using an appropriate miniature: pie, pill, calendar, time allocation, or bar set.
visual_anatomy.density: Extremely high: the matrix is only navigable because the row dimension stays fixed while visual grammar changes to match the type of comparison.

motion.observed_state_change: The sampled intermediate state shows pie segments changing position or share, a diagonal reveal moving through lower rows, and result bars growing across level columns; the near-complete state settles into the full maturity matrix.
motion.motion_job: Reveal the difference in composition, commitment, and outcome across columns before allowing the reader to study a static self-assessment table.
motion.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Self-assess a current operating level without confusing maturity with one isolated metric.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Define a small number of levels, keep the comparison dimensions fixed, and assign each dimension the smallest visual encoding that makes its pattern inspectable.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use only when the levels are explicitly bounded and the dimensions are evidence-based or clearly framed as a judgement rubric; do not turn an arbitrary ranking into a false maturity model.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the strategy levels, maturity claims, dimensions, time allocations, pie/calendar/bar encodings, table geometry, rough title tag, palette, or animation sequence.

claim_boundary.note: The maturity levels, effort estimates, and result implications are creator assertions and must not become a Shetty’s Desk benchmark without independent definition and support.
